# Akasha Music

> Akasha Music is a music label and management company operating at the intersection of artist development, creative direction, and strategic growth. Founded in 2024, Akasha Music builds artists into enduring brands, movements, and cultural identities.

## Services

- Artist Management: Career strategy, touring, brand partnerships, and day-to-day operations
- Label Services & Distribution: Global distribution, playlist pitching, and release strategy
- A&R / Artist Development: Talent scouting, sonic identity, and long-term growth planning
- Marketing & Strategy: Campaign planning, digital marketing, social strategy, and PR
- Creative Direction: Visual identity, music videos, artwork, and brand world-building

## Artists

- [Xavier Weeks](https://akashamusic.info/artists/xavier-weeks): Genre-fluid artist with 250M+ streams, known for blending late 2000s euro dance pop with trap-inspired vocal delivery
- [August Grau](https://akashamusic.info/artists/august-grau): Lifelong multi-instrumentalist and producer with rare versatility
- [Lucus](https://akashamusic.info/artists/lucus): Writer, producer, multi-instrumentalist whose sound fuses genres into modern pop
- [Røverdatter](https://akashamusic.info/artists/roverdatter): Raw, poetic, and unfiltered — a symbol of wild freedom and quiet strength
